title: Uniforms / Front and back

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study

slide_intent: Make staff clothing part of the identity so people encounter the brand through service as well as signage.
strategic_value: Brown uniforms, warm stripes and a heritage phrase can connect Burger King staff with the food story.
demonstration: Two people model front and back views of brown uniforms against orange; the apron carries a stacked flame-grilling phrase.
practical_value: Compare how a garment uses a large message on the front and restrained stripes across the back.

content_islands.name: Front view
content_islands.spec: Place the apron-wearing figure at left with the large yellow heritage phrase.

content_islands.name: Back view
content_islands.spec: Place the second figure facing away at right, showing shoulder stripes and tied apron straps.

reference_purposes.Application: The identity appears on staff uniforms with front and back treatments.
